certification.name: CREST Certified Incident Manager
certification.description: Certified-level exam for incident response managers with a multiple-choice component and a written component of long-form and scenario questions, covering containment, evidence handling, communications, recovery and legal issues. Delivered in two parts at Pearson VUE, with part 2 taken within three months of part 1.
certification.currency_note: Certified-level exams are listed at GBP 1,600 in two separately booked parts; the page does not say whether the price covers both parts
